0.title: SURVIVE!
paragraphs: Guide the Knight to survive as long as possible using only one click at a time!
The game ends when your Lifespan or HP reaches 0, so be careful.
Getting hit by the Enemy reduces your HP, while your Lifespan decreases gradually over time.

1.title: TRIGGER!
paragraphs: You are about to encounter an "Event". The cursor will change depending on the event, whether you are upgrading your weapon or armor (which also restores HP) or buying items.
Click to trigger the event! Don't be late or you'll miss it. Triggering events requires some gold, though, so be careful!
The interface shows upcoming events. Use it to plan ahead!

2.title: RESTORATION!
paragraphs: Ah! A Soul Shrine ahead! If you find a Soul Shrine along the way, you can spend some of your gold to fully restore your Lifespan. Just click when the cursor changes shape to trigger the event!
It is the only way to restore your Lifespan and prolong your survival. Please save some gold for it!

3.title: BATTLE!
paragraphs: Battles in this game are automatic. The Knight will try to defeat the enemy on her own. Please cheer for her!
However, if you have items in your inventory, you can use them by clicking the mouse button to turn the tide of battle (sometimes)!
Defeating enemies grants you gold, which you can spend to trigger events, such as upgrading your weapon. Enemies get stronger over time, so you should too!

4.title: I'M FADING!
paragraphs: Uh-oh, the Blademaster's Lifespan is nearly depleted. She starts to fade! Solution: Restore it by triggering a Soul Shrine event.
Don't worry, Soul Shrines are plentiful, so we will find one in a short time. Hopefully.

5.title: I'M WOUNDED!
paragraphs: Ouchie! The Blademaster is low on HP! If her HP reaches 0, she'll die! Help! Solution: Use an Elixir or upgrade your Armor.
Getting slashed by a sword really hurts! Luckily, we have some spare Elixir, right? ...Right?
